name: Hayate no Gotoku!! Nightmare Paradise
original_name: ハヤテのごとく！！ナイトメアパラダイス
source:
In the game, Hayate and the Heroines want to clean the Sanzenin family mansion's underground library. In the library they find a book with blank pages. All the girls fall into a dream world because of a curse created by Mikage Watarase. Mikage tells Hayate if he wants to wake up Nagi and the others he needs to enter and end each of their dreams. Hayate will face an adventure in order to wake the heroines from the curse.

[from [url=https://hayatenogotoku.fandom.com/wiki/Hayate_no_Gotoku!!:_Nightmare_Paradise]Fandom[/url]]
translation:
游戏中，疾风和女主角们想要清理三千院家的地下图书馆。他们在图书馆找到一本空白页的书。由于渡濑御影的诅咒，所有的女孩都陷入了梦境世界。御影告诉疾风，如果他想唤醒凪等人，他需要进入并结束他们各自的梦境。为了将女主角们从诅咒中唤醒，疾风将面临一场冒险。

[来自[url=https://hayatenogotoku.fandom.com/wiki/Hayate_no_Gotoku!!:_Nightmare_Paradise]粉丝圈[/url]]
